system.description: Eyes by Kikuyu Optics, arm by Nkembe Robotics, muscles by Helixtec, synthetic nerves by some bleeding-edge black clinic in Chiba. You're more machine than meat and more deadly than either. Some jobs require a soft touch, some a strong hand, others a dozen mags of caseless flechette rounds and twelve inches of retractable plastisteel inserted at high velocity into various reluctant organs. Those are the jobs you like. After all, you paid a lot for those mods, it'd be a shame not to use 'em.
